name: eur-lex-search
display_name: EUR-Lex and French Case Law Search
description: Search EUR-Lex legal documents and French case law using MCP tools.
long_description: Local MCP Bundle for querying EUR-Lex via SOAP, Judilibre, and Legifrance case-law funds via PISTE sandbox credentials with strict input validation, timeout controls, and consistent structured JSON responses for tool consumers.

tools.name: expert_search
tools.description: Run an EUR-Lex expert query (expert syntax only, e.g. DN = 32016R0679) and return normalized results.

tools.name: get_document_by_celex
tools.description: Fetch a document by exact CELEX identifier.

tools.name: get_legal_text
tools.description: Retrieve legal text by CELEX (article-level, recitals-only, or full text). Default language is French and can be changed.

tools.name: get_document_toc
tools.description: Retrieve the document table of contents (chapters/sections/articles) with numbering and titles. Default language is French and can be changed.

tools.name: search_eu_case_law
tools.description: Search EUR-Lex EU case-law only (CELEX sector 6) with simple filters or an expert query fragment.

tools.name: get_case_law_by_celex
tools.description: Fetch a European Union case-law document by exact CELEX sector-6 identifier.

tools.name: search_french_case_law
tools.description: Search French case law across Judilibre and Legifrance, with automatic routing for judicial, administrative, constitutional, financial, and CNIL decisions.

tools.name: get_french_case_law_decision
tools.description: Fetch a French case-law decision from Judilibre or Legifrance by id or by metadata fallback.

tools.name: get_french_case_law_taxonomy
tools.description: Fetch unified French case-law taxonomy/schema metadata for Judilibre and Legifrance funds.

tools.name: get_judilibre_taxonomy
tools.description: Deprecated alias for Judilibre taxonomy values used by French case-law search filters.

piste_sandbox_client_id.title: PISTE Sandbox Client ID
piste_sandbox_client_id.description: PISTE OAuth client id for Légifrance sandbox access. Also usable as an OAuth fallback for Judilibre.

piste_sandbox_client_secret.title: PISTE Sandbox Client Secret
piste_sandbox_client_secret.description: PISTE OAuth client secret for Légifrance sandbox access. Also usable as an OAuth fallback for Judilibre.

piste_sandbox_api_key.title: PISTE Sandbox API Key
piste_sandbox_api_key.description: PISTE API key used as the sandbox KeyId header for Judilibre. Légifrance uses OAuth when client credentials are configured.

default_timeout_ms.title: Default timeout (ms)
default_timeout_ms.description: Default tool request timeout in milliseconds.

max_page_size.title: Maximum page size
max_page_size.description: Upper limit for result page size.

allow_insecure_http.title: Allow insecure EUR-Lex transport
allow_insecure_http.description: Allow HTTP endpoint if HTTPS endpoint is unavailable.
